thread:
Nina: Quick one — noticed async embeddings.rerank returns a different Python type than sync. Sync returns list[tuple], async returns dict with 'scores'. Breaks our type hints and the batching helper.

Raj: Ugh, I hit this yesterday. The async path was refactored to reduce allocations and now returns the raw API payload.

Luca: Repro: ```py
# sync
out = client.rerank(query, docs)
# -> [("a", 0.8), ("b", 0.2)]

# async
out = await client.rerank(query, docs)
# -> {"scores": [0.8, 0.2], "items": [{"id":"a"},{"id":"b"}]}
```

Nina: The typed alias RerankItems = List[Tuple[str, float]] is failing mypy in our pipeline. Also async path surfaces immediate 401s when tokens expire; sync triggers refresh and retries.

Raj: Two bugs then: response-shape parity and async auth refresh.

Luca: I propose small steps: 1) add a normalization function used by both clients to return a stable List[Tuple[str,float]]; 2) implement an async token_refresh coroutine in auth middleware that retries once; 3) add a small async example in sdk-examples/python showing the batcher.

Nina: I'll own the normalization + tests. I'll add tests/embeddings/test_rerank_parity.py with both sync/async asserts and a mypy check.

Raj: I'll take auth middleware. Plan: add auth/aio_middleware.py with async refresh_token() and a retry hook. Keep retry count 1.

Luca: I'll add the sample app and update docs. Also suggest a temporary shim in async client to run normalize() on dict payloads to reduce user impact.

ci-bot: build triggered: sdk/pull/920 - failing test tests/embeddings/test_rerank_parity.py::test_async_shapes - AssertionError: shapes differ.

Nina: I'll push a small fix to call normalize on async return. We should aim to replace shim with proper typed dataclass in next minor.

Raj: Auth PR ready at github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2367, adds aio refresh and tests.

Luca: Examples PR: github.com/redwood/sdk/pull/921 — adds sdk-examples/python/async_rerank_batching.py and updates README notes on parity.

ci-bot: build fixed on sdk/pull/920 after normalization shim added and mypy test updated.

Nina: Good. After auth PR lands let's run e2e on staging to catch any remaining 401 flakiness.

Raj: Will do. I'll add a hermetic fixture to simulate expired tokens in pytest-asyncio.

Luca: Timeline: try to get patch release out in 48 hours if CI stays green. Follow-up issue to replace shims with typed dataclass and remove legacy tuple alias.

Nina: Thanks — assigning PRs: nina -> sdk#920 (normalize + tests), raj -> infra#2367 (aio auth), luca -> sdk#921 (examples + docs).
